run_blob_detector: run a ROS node to detect colored blobs from a specified camera using absl flags
run_blob_detector_with_visualization: run the blob detector with visualization enabled to publish helper images of detected blobs
run_blob_detector_with_toolkit: run the blob detector with the YUV GUI toolkit to tune detection parameters
run_blob_detector_custom_props: run the blob detector tracking custom colored props like green, red, or blue
review_main: review the main function that initializes the blob detector ROS node and spins it
